known.via: English Wikipedia "El Vicario" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Vino de Pago estate in Ciudad Real, formed in 2019 and inside the La Mancha DO area. A Vino de Pago applies to a single estate, not a region. Allowed grapes include Tempranillo, Syrah, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, plus Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc.
